Summary
Dio Rettori discusses the operational realities of enterprise AI inference. Moving beyond fast token generation, he explores why inference requires dedicated systems engineering, tackles GPU utilization pitfalls, compares on-prem versus cloud TCO, and analyzes multi-agent latency determinism. He shares why teams must embed domain ontology directly into models rather than relying solely on RAG.

Bio
Dio Rettori leads Product for Global AI Infrastructure Platforms at JPMorganChase, bringing 25+ years of experience. He previously oversaw the firm's multi-cloud strategy and led cloud transformation for Asset & Wealth Management, modernizing apps and driving cloud adoption at scale. Earlier, he held product and marketing leadership roles at Red Hat, Pivotal, and Solo.io in cloud-native solutions.

About the conference
QCon AI is a practitioner-led event focused entirely on the engineering discipline required to scale these workloads safely. It provides direct
access to the architectural playbooks and failure metrics that peer organizations use in production.
